description: Defines callback classes for cookie store operations in Chromium, including mechanisms for waiting, result storage, and thread validation.

classes.name: CookieCallback
classes.description: Base class for cookie operation callbacks, manages thread validation and synchronization.

classes.name: ResultSavingCookieCallback
classes.description: Template class for callbacks that save results of cookie operations.

classes.name: NoResultCookieCallback
classes.description: Callback class for cookie operations that do not return a result.

classes.name: GetCookieListCallback
classes.description: Callback class for retrieving a list of cookies.

classes.name: GetAllCookiesCallback
classes.description: Callback class for retrieving all cookies.

classes.name: GetAllCookiesWithAccessSemanticsCallback
classes.description: Callback class for retrieving all cookies with access semantics.

methods.name: WaitUntilDone
methods.description: Blocks until the callback is invoked.

methods.name: was_run
methods.description: Checks if the callback was executed.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Executes the callback with the result or cookies.

methods.name: MakeCallback
methods.description: Creates a bound callback for asynchronous invocation.
